children: Michael John O'Connor disclosed a 16.0% stake in Rainmaker Worldwide Inc.'s common stock. He filed the Schedule 13D on Sep. 18, 2026, and his holdings include shares he owns directly plus shares issuable from a convertible note held by Larchwood Management Partners Inc., which he controls. The filing follows several stock transfers and sales since early 2025 and comes shortly after his September 2026 resignation as Rainmaker’s CEO.

O'Connor holds the position for investment and because Rainmaker paid part of his compensation in stock and debt that can convert into stock. He says he may buy or sell more shares and may convert the note into common stock, but he does not have specific plans for changes at Rainmaker such as mergers, board moves, or other corporate actions.

Michael John O'Connor is a Canadian investor and advisor who controls Larchwood Management Partners Inc., an Ontario-based management and consulting firm. He previously served as Chief Executive Officer and a director of Rainmaker Worldwide Inc. and resigned from those roles in September 2026. He often receives equity or convertible debt as payment for services and manages positions with an active, hands-on approach to client companies.
